privacy_list.title: Manage Note Access Policy
privacy_list.intro_private_by_default: Untrusted providers can only access the files listed below. Everything else stays private unless the provider is marked as trusted.
privacy_list.intro_public_by_default: Untrusted providers can access vault files by default, except for the files listed below as private. Trusted providers always bypass this restriction.
privacy_list.path_visibility_note: Private files are withheld from untrusted providers entirely — content, names and paths alike. Two exceptions: a private note that is open, selected, or graph-selected still has its path (and any selected text) sent with your message, and a private note's name can appear inside another note that links to it and isn't itself private. Rules here follow renames automatically, so you can freely rename or move files without breaking this list.
privacy_list.empty_exposed: No files are exposed to untrusted providers yet.
privacy_list.empty_all_exposed: Every file is exposed to untrusted providers.
privacy_list.empty_none_exposed: No files are exposed to untrusted providers.
privacy_list.picker_desc_expose: Select one or more vault files that untrusted providers are allowed to access.
privacy_list.picker_desc_private: Select one or more vault files to mark as private.
